text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, Nov 26 - Chittagong - Ten vessels in port of which 3 containers, 6 general import, 1 other. 22 Vessels due by 3/12 of which 10 containers, 3 general import, 3 fertiliser, 1 cement loader, 1 foodgrain, 4 other vessels. No berthing delays.

CHINA, Nov 23 - Taichung - Five vessels anchored, berthing delays grain 2-3 days, iron ore, coal, scrap, steel 1 day, others 1-2 days. Nov 25 - Keelung - Vessels in port 13 containers, 1 tanker, 8 other bulkers, 4 general cargo vessels waiting at outer anchorage, 3 containers, 3 other bulkers. Berthing delays containers 16 hours, bulkers 1 day. Kaohsiung - Vessels in port 8 containers, 9 tankers, 2 bulkers, 35 generals, 12 buoys.

INDIA, Nov 26 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 2-3 days, bulkers 9-10 days, general cargo 4-5 days. 8 Vessels loading at berth, 19 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 8 waiting at anchorage to load, 19 to discharge, 2 bunkering, 5 under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Indira dock lock gate damaged by a container vessel. Shipping movements hampered 14/11-18/11. Calcutta - 13 Vessels due of which 3 coking coal, 4 product tankers, 5 containers, 1 coal. Berthing delays expected. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 11 discharging, 1 discharging at anchorage, 2 bunkering.

Cochin - Three vessels due, 3 days delay expected, 2 vessels discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 under repairs/drydock. Mormugao - Vessels due, 2 pax, 1 lan, 1 phosphoric acid, 8 ores. Delays for ores 4-5 days. 9 Vessels loading at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 bunkering, 3 under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders. Kandla - Ten vessels due, 6-7 days delay expected, 5 vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging, 12 waiting at anchorage to load, 21 tankers berthed. Mangalore - 14 Vessels due, 2-3 days delay, 6 loading/ discharging at berth, 1 awaiting berth, 1 bunkering, 1 other.

Madras - Vessels due by 3/12, 8 containers, 7 general, 2 pax, 1 phosphoric acid, 4 coal, 2 iron ore, 1 palm oil, 1 lube oil, 1 stone. Delays expected coal/coke 5 days, fertiliser 4-5 days, scrap 5-6 days, containers 1-2 days, iron ore 1 day, others 2-3 days. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 15 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 20 to discharge. Mangalore - 16 Vessels due, 2-3 days delay expected, 6 loading /discharging at berth, 3 waiting, 1 other vessel. Jawaharlal Nehru - No fertiliser/raw material vessels due, 15-20 days berthing delay, 1 tanker/iron ore due, up to 1 days delay expected, 2 discharging at berth (raw material/fertiliser). 1 Tanker/iron ore waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 others waiting to discharge (fertiliser/raw material). Paradip - Vessels due, 1 coal, up to 1 days berthing delay, 1 loading at berth, 2 discharging, 1 at anchorage to load.

Tuticorin - One vessel due, 1-2 days delay, 3 loading at berth, 6 discharging, 1 discharging at anchorage, 6 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 to discharge. Visakhapatnam - Vessels due, 2 import iron ore, up to 1 days delay, 1 meal, 7-8 days delay, 1 dap, 2-3 days delay, 1 urea, 2-3 days delay, 1 coking coal, 7-8 days delay, 2 rbd palm oil, 3-4 days delay, 1 phosphoric acid, 2-3 days delay, 1 each iron ore, rock phosphate, magnesite, 7-8 days delay, 1 caustic soda, 1-2 days delay, 1 general cargo, 1 limestone, 3-4 days delay, 1 sulphur, 7-8 days delay, 1 logs, 1 ammonia, 2-3 days delay. 6 Loading at berth, 6 discharging, 5 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 5 to load.

MALAYSIA, Nov 27 - Port Kelang north port - Container berths 8 vessels alongside, 14 waiting. Deep draft conventional wharf 4 alongside, 1 berthing 27/11, 5 waiting, with waiting time 2 days. Dry bulk, 1 vessel alongside, 1 waiting, waiting time 2 days. Bulk terminal No.25 closed for repairs until further notice. West port - 2 Container vessels alongside, 4 conventional vessels alongside, 2 cement carriers alongside discharging, 1 wharf occupied by passenger vessel, 1 days waiting time. Dredging operations as follows berth 01W from 2/11-28/11, berth 02W 29/11-6/12, berths 04W-05W 1/2/97-10/2/97, berth 03W 11/2-19/2/97. All these berths for conventional vessels.

MAURITIUS, Nov 26 - Port Louis - Due to strikes in Reunion Island, all vessels have been diverted to Port Louis since end of last week, 2 days delay being experienced. All berths occupied. Two container vessels alongside for discharging and loading, 4 general cargo vessels discharging, 2 container vessels and 1 general cargo awaiting berth, 16 vessels due by 3/12, 1 vessel in drydock.

PAKISTAN, Nov 25 - Karachi - Six vessels due, up to 24 hours delay expected. 2 Rice vessels loading at berth, 3 container vessels loading/discharging at berth. 12 Vessels discharging at berth (sugar, urea, dap, general cargo, mogas, crude oil, gas oil). 3 Waiting at anchorage to load (chrome, rice) 6 to discharge (containers, fertiliser, oil tanker, gas oil, hsd) 1 awaiting orders. Port Qasim - Four vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (sugar, general cargo, lpg, soybean). Vessels discharging at berth, 1 barge with tug, sugar, pig iron, wheat, steel, slabs, pipes).

SINGAPORE, Nov 26 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 9 container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 15 container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 12 container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang - 3 general cargo vessels berthed. Jurong - 2 Bulk cargo/steel /general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminal/sbm buoys - 18 Tankers berthed. Minimum berthing delays at all facilities.

SOUTH KOREA, Nov 26 - Inchon - 78 Vessels in port (49 berthed, 29 anchored) of which 6 each general cargo, logs, containers, 4 each steel, corn, 3 each coils/cars, 2 each silica sand, timber, plywood, 1 each fertiliser, h-beam, talc, tapioca, soda, pulp, molasses, ilmenite, steel plates, soybeans, raw sugar. Anchored, 5 general cargo, 4 each logs, containers, 3 steel, 2 each coils, pig iron, 1 each corn, pulp, soymeal, wheat, plywood, steel plates, soybeans, copper, cars. Approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Busan - 180 Vessels in port (49 berthed, 131 anchored including 68 Laid up) of which 36 general cargo, 6 container, 4 scrap, 3 coal, 63 awaiting berth, 2 days delay expected.

Pohang - 23 In port (20 berthed, 3 anchored) of which discharging 2 each billets, coils, iron ore, pipes, scrap, 1 each coal, plates, chrome, pig iron, benzene. 5 Vessels loading steel. 3 Vessels awaiting berth, 1 days delay expected. Ulsan - 23 in port (21 berthed, 2 anchored) of which discharging 2 each feed meal, crude oil, 1 each woodchip, coal, cement, styrene monomer, mono ethyl glycol, raw sugar, salt, rock phosphate, fertiliser, zinc concentrates, acetic acid, sorghum, propane, bunker-c loading 2 general cargo, 1 ammonium sulphate. 2 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 2 days delay expected. Masan - Five vessels berthed of which discharging 2 steel scrap, 2 pig iron. 1 container vessel loading, no berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, Nov 26 - Colombo - vessels due 5 breakbulk, 8 containers. Delays 3-4 days for conventional vessels. 19 vessels loading at berth of which 4 essential services, 13 containers, 1 general cargo, 1 granite blocks. Discharging at berth, 1 bagged sugar, 3 bagged rice, 3 general cargo (country crafts), 1 bagged flour, 13 container vessels, 1 bulk lpg, 1 bagged fertiliser, 1 bulk mop, 1 bulk molasses waiting at anchorage to load. 8 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge of which 4 containers, 2 bagged fertiliser, 1 bagged rice, 1 bagged pulses. 1 bunkering outside harbour, 4 under repair, 4 awaiting orders. Shortage of stevedores continues. Galle - One vessel loading at berth. Trincomalee - Three vessels discharging at berth.
THAILAND, Nov 25 - Bangkok - 91 vessels in port of which 4 containers, 4 tankers, 83 other bulkers and general cargo vessels. 1 vessel waiting at outer anchorage, no berthing delays expected.
